maria (PM): Quick sync — we can't meet the launch SLA unless we cut scope. proposing a minimal cutset to protect the Apr 8 launch. see proposal below.

maria (PM): ```
Cut for MVP (ship/launch):
- Remove tenant self-service SSO federation (defer to v1)
- Disable advanced telemetry dashboards (retain lightweight ingest only)
- Defer multi-tenant routing per-tenant custom rules (use default routing)
- Postpone admin console bulk user import (v1)
Keep for MVP:
- Core generation + streaming + promptstore
- Embeddings cache + basic reranking
- Basic onboarding + billing flow
```

kevin (eng): Can we avoid a hard cut for SSO? maybe ship a stub that redirects to support.

dmitri (ae): We need to be careful — Acme needs SSO for pilot. Can we make SSO an opt-in v1 feature so they can onboard with an account team workaround?

alexa (prodops): +1 to stub redirect. Also propose we mark telemetry as "diagnostic-only" in the UI so we don't hold up launch.

sam (design): If SSO is stubbed, I'll wire a lightweight modal that explains enterprise onboarding and collects interest — can ship by Mar 30.

maria (PM): Plan: ship SSO-stub + modal for MVP, full federation becomes v1. telemetry: ingest only, dashboards v1. freeze for launch candidate 03/28. target launch 04/08.

kevin (eng): Infra check: canary needs 48h and a fallback policy to older model variant. also need to disable emb-cache warming for tenant routing to avoid noisy neighbor warms. I can deliver canary plan by EOD.

launch-bot: Release window reserved: 2024-04-08 10:00 UTC. Canary slot: 2024-04-06 02:00 UTC.

maria (PM): Great — @dmitri @alexa, please identify two customers for a restricted pilot and confirm they accept SSO-stub behavior.

dmitri (ae): I'll ping Acme & BetaCorp today and note the manual onboarding path.

alexa (prodops): I'll update runbooks and docs, and add a short rollout checklist (feature flags, telemetry switches).

maria (PM): Thanks team. follow-ups: kevin sends canary + fallback plan, sam ships modal mock, dmitri confirms pilots. We'll re-evaluate any remaining scope on Mar 26 checkpoint. :thumbsup:
